first.rationale: Promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. Verify memory_73 to confirm effects on qualification, retention, margins, and payback before committing, since headline revenue lift may not imply sustainable long-term qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a controlled onboarding-simplification experiment. It directly addresses the concurrent declines in onboarding completion and activation, while inherited evidence links simplification to faster time-to-value and durable first-week activation. Do not pursue promotional pricing: the verified source shows a 12% decline in 30-day retention despite short-term revenue lift. Measure qualified revenue and retention as downstream guardrails so completion gains are not mistaken for sustainable value.
